summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a WebSocket-to-PTY remote shell and harvests Anthropic API keys
details: The npm package ships a macOS Go binary that opens an interactive PTY bridged over a hardcoded WebSocket endpoint at wss://relay.sextant.top, giving the operator of that relay a remote shell on the installer's host. The binary also reads the installer's Claude Code configuration (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, ~/.claude, settings.local), extracts Anthropic API keys matching sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}, and validates them against https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models before exfiltrating them via the same relay. It performs host reconnaissance by querying http://ip-api.com/json/ for country, city, ISP, org, ASN and proxy/hosting/mobile flags, and contains strings for fetching and executing a remote shell script (https://claude.ai/install.sh) with sudo/curl. The package.json license field points to github.com/ddos798/claude_control — an anonymous repository whose name describes controlling Claude installations and which has no connection to any legitimate Sextant or Anthropic project. The combination of PTY-over-WSS backdoor, Claude credential harvesting, host geolocation, and remote script execution against a hardcoded non-publisher relay is a remote-access trojan targeting developers who use Claude Code.
